body.text: Yes. Upgrade, downgrade, or cancel at any time from your site dashboard. Changes take effect at the start of your next billing cycle. No penalties, no lock-in.

items.title: What happens when I exceed my bandwidth limit?

body.text: Your site stays live. We will notify you and offer an automatic plan upgrade so visitors never see downtime. Overages are billed at fair, transparent rates.

items.title: Is there a free trial for Premium?

body.text: All paid plans include a 14-day free trial with full access to every feature. If you cancel before the trial ends, you will not be charged.

items.title: Do I need to know code to use Apogee?

body.text: No. Apogee is a visual-first platform — you design directly in the browser. For teams that want code-level control, we also offer a full REST API and MCP server integration.

items.title: What is AEO and how does it differ from SEO?

body.text: AI Engine Optimization (AEO) helps your content appear in AI-generated answers and citations — not just traditional search rankings. Premium and Enterprise plans include native AEO tooling.
